question: Run GSEA on ranked gene list to identify the most enriched gene sets of biological processes. Report the full enrichment results and the top 5 significantly enriched gene sets.

expected_output.guidelines: All gene-set records must match the reference in term identity and enrichment direction; NES may vary by 5% relative absolute error and FDR q-val by 10% relative absolute error due to permutation; column order and extra columns may differ.
Top-5 gene sets must match the reference in term identity and enrichment direction; NES may vary by 5% relative absolute error and ranking may shift by +/-2 positions; column order may differ.
